''See also: [[Imperial Palace (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Imperial]] Palace is a massive, incredibly opulent complex located in the Capital, occupying nearly one-fifth of the city's area. Often described as being like a city in its own right, it houses tens of thousands of [[inhabitants]] and staff. The structure contains several significant locations, including an audience hall, the Emperor's private quarters and [[armory]], and a three-story building known as the [[Emperor’s Stage]] used for addressing large crowds in the palace [[courtyard]]. The facility also features a [[throne]] room that serves as a symbolic seat of power for The Empire{{!}}the Empire, though it is distinct from the [[Optasia]], which was the Emperor's actual [[throne]] used to amplify [[Reading]] and respond to [[Great Elders]]. Historically, the palace has been a site of conflict, suffering damage from battles with [[Elderspawn]] and experiencing periods where it was lost to Elder control. It has also served as a hub for imperial administration, including financial record-keeping and the management of the empire's treasury.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Imperial]] Palace is a massive complex that functions much like its own city and houses the [[Emperor's personal rooms]] as well as his [[private armory]]. [[Calder]], [[Jerri]], and their crew traveled to the location, where [[Calder]] was eventually released from the site. While the palace has recently been subject to attacks, it remains the only place from which the [[Optasia]] can be seen. Despite a search of the grounds that yielded no trace of [[Meia]], [[Calder]] has found a sense of being at home within the complex.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Imperial]] Palace is a massive complex characterized by a red-tiled mass of roofs that occupies nearly twenty percent of the Capital. Within its grounds, which include dungeons and the Emperor's Stage, [[Calder]] returned to be kept under observation. Following a procession held within the complex, a battle broke out that resulted in the palace falling, potentially to the [[Independents]]. The site of this conflict is marked by flagstones spotted with [[Baldezar Kern]]'s [[blood]] and the imprisonment of [[Jerri]] by [[Kelarac]]. Although any [[Elderspawn]] attempting to crash through its walls would be annihilated, the palace ultimately fell following [[Calder]]'s death.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The procession takes place within the [[Imperial]] Palace complex.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
